# Sensitive filenames (one ERE per line, #-comments ignored). Read by the
# secret gate in .github/workflows, and by the local pre-push hook, so both
# agree on what counts. These paths must never be committed, whatever they hold.
(^|/)\.env(\.|$)
^id_rsa$|^id_ed25519$|^id_ecdsa$
\.pem$|\.key$|\.p12$|\.pfx$|\.jks$|\.keystore$|\.mobileprovision$
google-services\.json$|GoogleService-Info\.plist$
credentials$|kubeconfig$
\.tfstate$|\.tfvars$|\.vault-token$|\.netrc$|\.pgpass$|\.my\.cnf$
authorized_keys$|known_hosts$
opencode-warden\.json$|opencode\.jsonc$
